questions.text: Zara, Really sorry - I have to work late tonight so can't cook dinner after all. I know you're busy and your brother's coming round. Could you order a takeaway? I'll eat at work. Ali

options.label: C
options.text: eat the dinner that Ali has made.

questions.explanation:
Ali 说 “can't cook dinner... I'll eat at work”（无法做晚饭，自己在单位吃），让 Zara “order a takeaway”（点外卖），对应 B 选项 “have dinner without Ali”（没有 Ali 一起吃饭）。
A 选项 “buy something for Ali's dinner”（为 Ali 买晚餐）错误，Ali 自己在单位吃；C 选项 “eat Ali's made dinner”（吃 Ali 做的饭）与原文矛盾。

questions.text: For sale Traditional wooden dining table and chairs. Some damage to table top. Call Mark after 7 p.m. on 08732251983

options.label: A
options.text: The items he has got are not all in perfect condition.

options.label: B
options.text: You can contact him any time you like.

options.label: C
options.text: His furniture is not made in an old-fashioned style.

questions.explanation:
卖家提到 “Some damage to table top”（桌面有损坏），对应 A 选项 “items are not all in perfect condition”（物品并非全部完好）。
B 选项 “contact any time”（随时联系）错误，要求 “call after 7 p.m.”；C 选项 “not made in old-fashioned style”（非老式风格）与原文 “Traditional wooden”（传统木制）矛盾。

questions.text: This tennis equipment is for club members only. To hire rackets and balls for use on the court, see Reception.

options.label: A
options.text: You're not permitted to use this equipment unless you have club membership.

options.label: B
options.text: If you wish to become a member of the tennis club, ask at Reception.

options.label: C
options.text: Non-members must bring their own equipment to use on these courts.

questions.explanation:
原文 “This tennis equipment is for club members only”（网球设备仅限会员使用），对应 A 选项 “not permitted unless you have membership”（非会员不可用）。
B 选项 “ask at Reception to become member”（在前台申请会员）原文未提及，C 选项 “non-members must bring own equipment”（非会员必须自带设备）原文未说明，仅说会员可租用。

questions.text: Aiden, I'm afraid I'm unwell - I can't go to the running club today. But you should definitely go, even though it's your first time. Everyone in the group's really helpful - especially if you're new. Olivia

options.label: A
options.text: Olivia is encouraging Aiden to go running today.

options.label: B
options.text: Olivia wants Aiden to tell the group that she can't run today.

options.label: C
options.text: Olivia is letting Aiden know that the running group are expecting him today.

questions.explanation:
Olivia 说 “I can't go to the running club today. But you should definitely go”（我去不了，但你一定要去），对应 A 选项 “encouraging Aiden to go running”（鼓励 Aiden 去）。
B 选项 “want Aiden to tell the group she can't go”（让 Aiden 告知团队）和 C 选项 “running group are expecting him”（团队在等他）均未提及。

questions.text: College Art Class To prepare for next lesson, find out about famous landscape paintings so you can discuss them in class. We'll also use computers to look at pictures painted outdoors to inspire us.

options.label: A
options.text: Students will be working outdoors during their next art class.

options.label: B
options.text: Students must produce their next picture using painting software.

options.label: C
options.text: Students should do some research before the next session.

questions.explanation:
通知要求 “prepare for next lesson, find out about famous landscape paintings”（为下节课做准备，了解著名风景画），对应 C 选项 “should do some research before the next session”（课前做研究）。
A 选项 “work outdoors during next class”（下节课在户外创作）错误，原文说 “use computers to look at pictures painted outdoors”（用电脑看户外画作）；B 选项 “produce picture using painting software”（用软件作画）未提及，仅说用电脑看画。
